{{Recipesummary|category=Corn recipes|servings=4|time=20 minutes|difficulty=2|}}
'''Egidi''', also known as '''pounded corn''', is a typical Yoruba dish common among the people of Ondo state. It is served with various soups, such as as [[Cookbook:Nigerian Okra Soup|okro]], [[Cookbook:Ogbono Soup|ogbono]], and [[Cookbook:Egusi Soup|ẹgusi]] soups.

==Ingredients==
*Fresh [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]] kernels
*Leaves, for wrapping
*Water

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|Mortar and pestle]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stove]]
* Pot
* Bowl/plate 

==Procedure==
#Grind the corn kernels to make a paste.
#Wrap the paste using wrapping leaves.
#Cook for few minutes.
#Pound using mortar and pestle until the mixture is lump-free.
#Serve with soup.
